contea di ritrovamento: East Riding of Yorkshire (Inghilterra e Galles)
D/ IMP CARAVSIVS P F AVG ; R/ PAX AVG

Copper alloy Roman radiate of Carausius (286-293 AD) (Reece Period 14). obv legend: IMP CARAVSIVS P F AVG obv type: radiate bust facing right. rev legend: PAX AVG rev type: Pax standing left, holding branch and vertical sceptre. RIC V, pt 2, p. 535, no. 880. Finder's number 4. This coin is included in Sam Moorhead's corpus for RIC
